## Which environment variable keeps the server's full-text search index on disk so it isn't rebuilt every start?

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Search.md] ---
### The search index

# The search index
The server keeps a full-text index of the space and updates it as pages change, usually within a second. After the server starts, it builds or catches up the index in the background. Until that finishes, results come with a “Search index building” notice and may be incomplete.

Where the index lives:
* On a server with several spaces, under `search/indexes/` in the server’s data folder, so restarts reuse it.
* On a single-space server, in memory and rebuilt at every start, or in `SB_SEARCH_DIR` when it is set (see [[#Single-space servers]]).
* In SilverBullet Desktop, in the app’s data folder.

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Search.md] ---
### Semantic search > Single-space servers

## Single-space servers
Set `SB_SEARCH_DIR` to a writable folder outside your space to persist search indexes. Without it, full-text search runs in memory and rebuilds on startup. To enable semantic search, also set `SB_SEARCH_MODEL` to one of the model IDs above. Model files are stored in the search directory. Restart the server after changing these environment variables. See [[Install/Configuration]].

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Search.md] ---
### Semantic search > SilverBullet Desktop

## SilverBullet Desktop
Open **Settings → Advanced** and choose a model under **Semantic search**. The download starts right away. Semantic search is then on for every space. To keep a space on full-text search only, open its settings, go to **Advanced** and uncheck **Semantic search**. The same 5,000-page rule applies. Changing the model reloads the open spaces, after asking first. The model and the indexes live in the app’s data folder.

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Search.md] ---
### Semantic search

# Semantic search
When enabled (default off), SilverBullet offers semantic search — search based on meaning. It runs an embedding model on the server itself (in Desktop, on your computer). Beyond downloading the model, no data leaves your server/desktop. On a server with several spaces, an administrator turns it on in the dashboard. Single-space servers and Desktop are covered under [[#Single-space servers]] and [[#SilverBullet Desktop]].

1. In the dashboard, open **Admin** → **Search** and choose a model.
2. To keep a space on full-text search only, open its settings, go to **Search** and uncheck **Semantic search**.

After selecting a model, it is downloaded once. Choosing a model turns semantic search on for every space by default. The dashboard asks first, saying how many spaces will build a semantic index.

Once the semantic index is ready, a **Related Pages** panel becomes available (toggle it with `Navigate: Related Pages`). It lists up to 5 content pages, each with a formatted excerpt from its closest matching passage. From [[Space Lua]], `search.related()` returns the same list (see [[API/search]]).

* **`granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2` (default):** 52 languages (and 200+ with less training), a 220 MB download and about 490 MB of memory.
* **`multilingual-e5-small`:** About 100 languages, a 488 MB download and about 590 MB of memory.

Granite Embedding 97M Multilingual R2 (IBM, Apache-2.0) is the recommended model and comes first in the list. It finds paraphr

### Legacy “single-space” mode options > General configuration

## General configuration
* `SB_FOLDER`: The data folder to serve, e.g. `SB_FOLDER=/home/user/silverbullet`. In single-space mode this folder is your space, in multi-space mode it holds the server configuration and (by default) the spaces, see [[Dashboard]].
* `SB_INDEX_PAGE` *(legacy)*: Sets the default page to load, defaults to `index`. Prefer the per-space **Index page** setting in the [[Dashboard]] (**Space settings → General**).
* `SB_SPACE_IGNORE`: Hide paths from SilverBullet using gitignore-style patterns, e.g. `SB_SPACE_IGNORE="IgnoreMe/*"`. The space folder’s actual `.gitignore` file is not read.
* `SB_SEARCH_DIR`: A writable folder outside the space where search keeps its full-text index (so it is not rebuilt at every start) and, with `SB_SEARCH_MODEL`, the model and the semantic index. The space folder may stay read-only. Unset (the default), the index is kept in memory. Use one folder per server. See [[Search]].
* `SB_SEARCH_MODEL`: Adds semantic search with this model: `granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2` (recommended, about 220 MB) or `multilingual-e5-small` (about 488 MB). Requires `SB_SEARCH_DIR`. The model is downloaded on first start. See [[Search]].
* `SB_HTTP_LOGGING`: Set to any value to enable HTTP logging
* `SB_LOG_PUSH`: Set to any value to ask clients to push their logs to the server (for debugging purposes)
* `SB_DISABLE_SERVICE_WORKER`: Set to any value to disable the client-side service worker for all clients. In this mode, [[Sync]] is disabled
